# BuildFlashCards.com

> > A free, no-signup flashcard builder that lets students create study materials instantly without registration or account requirements.

BuildFlashCards.com is a privacy-focused, browser-based flashcard creation tool designed for rapid learning. It supports CSV imports from Excel and Google Sheets, integrates spaced-repetition study techniques, and serves students and professionals preparing for exams.

## Key Topics

- Flashcard creation
- No signup required
- CSV import
- Spaced repetition
- Privacy-focused
- Browser-based
- Free learning tool
- Study shortcuts
- Excel/Google Sheets integration
- Active recall
- Language learning
- Exam preparation
- Quick-start
- Study techniques
